constraints.constraint: Always use active_tenant_id || tenant_id pattern via getTenantId() for super_admin support
Use checkDAEPAdminRole() for role-based access control on mutation actions
Log all mutations to admin_audit_log via logAuditEvent()
Use Zod schemas for all input validation before database operations
Use revalidatePath() after mutations to refresh cached data
Separations are bidirectional - query for student in EITHER student_a_id OR student_b_id
Filter expired separations: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()
Building section blocking: rooms in same building_section are all blocked, not just one room
Never hardcode colors - use theme variables from DAEPThemeContext
Touch targets minimum 44x44px for iPad compatibility
Use color + icon for status (not color alone) for accessibility
Confirmation modal required for destructive actions (remove separation)
